document_metadata.title: POLARIS Stage 8.1 EMS V4.G Single-Horizon Mechanism Isolation Specification & Parameter Freeze Gate

authoritative_v3_handoff.governing_interpretation: V3 mechanism evidence indicates that the Class F improvement is strongly consistent with reduced optimizer sensitivity to later-horizon forecast-dependent operational costs. Individual forecast-horizon contributions were not isolated.
authoritative_v3_handoff.classification: B — STRONGLY SUPPORTED BUT NOT FULLY ISOLATED

known_evidence.unresolved_question: The fact that h=14 has the largest observed bias does NOT establish that h=14 caused the V2 diesel outcome. V4.G exists specifically to test that unresolved question.

authoritative_v3_handoff.experimental_framing: SINGLE-HORIZON MECHANISM ISOLATION (NOT a proven remedy, NOT a fix for V2, NOT declared the cause of V2 diesel use).

index_semantics.forecast_horizon_h: h in [1..24] (1-indexed forecast horizon hours, h = t + 1)

parameter_freeze.parameter_provenance: Inherited directly from frozen V3 Class F weighting at t=13 (0.95^13 = 0.513342...). NOT an empirically optimized parameter.
parameter_freeze.tuning_prohibition: No tuning, no grid search, no result-dependent adjustments.

source_inspection_audit.intended_v4g_modification: Replace line 97 (w_t = gamma ** t) with single-horizon vector logic: w_t = 0.5133 if t == 13 else 1.0
Pass v4g mode configuration parameters to optimizer config dictionary

future_3arm_experiment_design.primary_endpoint: Total diesel fuel liters per 24h origin (L/origin)

mechanism_analysis_plan.comparison: Arm 3 (V4.G) vs Arm 2 (V3 Reference) vs Arm 1 (Control)

possible_outcomes.outcome_a: V4.G produces a clear isolated operational change matching V3 Class F, confirming h=14 / t=13 is the primary driver.
possible_outcomes.outcome_b: V4.G produces partial fuel savings, showing h=14 / t=13 is material but multi-horizon decay is also required.
possible_outcomes.outcome_c: V4.G produces little/no change relative to Control, weakening the hypothesis that h=14 / t=13 is dominant.
possible_outcomes.outcome_d: V4.G produces unexpected operational/safety degradation, refuting the candidate mechanism.

candidate_classification.justification: Exact intervention, index mapping (t=13 <-> h=14), weight value (w13=0.5133), objective scope, source code insertion point, and 3-Arm comparison protocol are fully specified and demonstrable from current source code inspection.

next_governance_gate.next_gate: V4.G IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORIZATION & STATIC IMPLEMENTATION GATE
next_governance_gate.action: Authorize single-point code modification in milp.py and perform static implementation audit before any execution.
